name: ListAgentStorages

parameters.help_en: The status of the agent storage
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of tagged resources to return in the current request
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求返回标签资源的最大个数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token used to query the next page when the expected total number of tagged resources to return is greater than the specified MaxResults value. This parameter has a value only when not all tagged resources are returned
parameters.help_zh: 当预期返回的标签资源总数大于设置的MaxResults时，将作为查询后续页的凭证。只有当资源标签未全部返回时，此参数才有值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the agent storage
parameters.name: agent_storage_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. You can obtain the ID from the Resource Group console
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID，可通过资源组控制台查询
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The list of agent storage names, which is used to query multiple specified agent storages in batches
parameters.help_zh: 智能体存储名称列表，用于批量查询多个指定智能体存储
parameters.name: agent_storage_name_list
